style: Create original high-fantasy game art with chunky hand-inked dark contours, flat gouache-like color masses and restrained dry-brush texture, matching a painted fantasy deckbuilder; adventurous with a light touch of humor. This art belongs to the SHARED WORLD that every playable hero visits, so it must never show or hint at any particular hero: no dragon scales, claws, tails, wings, horns or dragon fire, and no people. The world is an original realm of enchanted forest ruins overrun by ancient clockwork golems: weathered pale stone and colored sandstone, tarnished bronze and brass, gears and rivets, moss, ivy and small ferns, oak, leather, old parchment and ivory, and softly glowing teal rune light (abstract glowing lines, never letters). Palette: blackened iron #2A2426, weathered stone, tarnished bronze #8A6A3A, ivory #EFE2C4, amber gold #F2A93B, mossy greens and teal rune light #3FC9B5, with crimson, plum-purple or sky-blue accents only where the subject calls for them. Bold readable silhouettes, two-step cel shading and selective warm highlights; reserve soft emission for runes, magic and VFX. Do not imitate any existing game, franchise character, emblem or official artwork. Include no text, letters, numerals, labels, logos, emblems, watermarks or typographic symbols, and respect each asset's stated background and framing requirements.

assets.brief: Simple readable card frame (status skill)
assets.prompt: A clean, simple, flat trading-card frame template in the style of classic deckbuilder cards. Card body color: muted plum (#6B4A63) with a darker inner border (#48304A); ribbon in dark plum (#2F1F31) with a thin cream edge. ART WINDOW SHAPE: plain rectangle with small rounded corners. STRICT LAYOUT on a portrait card (width W, height H), flat front view, no perspective: the card body fills the whole canvas edge to edge with small rounded corners and a thin dark ink outline (#142C30). NAME RIBBON: a horizontal banner across the top from x=6% to x=94%, y=3% to y=14%, flat and empty in the middle (text is added later). COST SOCKET: an empty round socket centered at x=11%, y=8%, diameter 18% of W, overlapping the left end of the ribbon. ART WINDOW: x=12% to 88%, y=16% to 55%; fill the window interior with PURE FLAT MAGENTA #FF00FF (it will be cut out), with a clean frame border around it. TYPE TAG: a small flat dark plate centered at x=36%-64%, y=55%-61%, empty. TEXT PLATE: x=9% to 91%, y=63% to 95%, a FLAT LIGHT CREAM (#F3E8CF) panel with rounded corners and a thin border, completely plain and empty for dark text. Keep decoration minimal and flat: no vines, no leaves over the plates, no gadgets, no texture noise, no text. Background outside the card must be transparent.
